name: US equity stress
summary: S&P 500 recovers part of its 5 Nov fall as chip stocks bounce; VIX 25.6 and index 5.7% off its high
state: US stocks partly recovered on 6 Nov after the 5 Nov sell-off, with the Philadelphia chip index up about 4% in early trading (BNN Bloomberg/Reuters). The S&P 500 closed near 7,377, 5.7% below its 52-week high, and the VIX closed at 25.6 (Yahoo Finance): both inside the Watch band and below the VIX 30 Alert line.
for_you: Investors and pension savers with US equity exposure face larger day-to-day swings while volatility stays elevated. Describes market conditions only; it is not advice.
rubric_hit: VIX 25.6 in 20–30 Watch band; S&P drawdown 5.7% in 5–15% band

sources.title: BNN Bloomberg (Reuters) — Wall Street stocks in relief rally after heavy AI-related selloff

why: The S&P 500 is the world's risk barometer; sharp falls and spiking volatility transmit to pensions, credit and confidence globally.
drivers: Earnings, interest-rate expectations, liquidity, geopolitical shocks, positioning and leverage.

rubric.alert: VIX > 30, or drawdown > 15%, or a market-wide circuit breaker trips.
rubric.normal: VIX < 20 and S&P 500 drawdown from 52-week high < 5%.
